title: Caymus Friendsgiving
seo_title: Caymus Friendsgiving Wine Dinner in Ozark, MO
description: This Caymus Friendsgiving Wine Dinner is a Thanksgiving-style meal paired with Caymus wines, so guests can enjoy a holiday dinner without the shopping, cooking, or cleanup. Happy hour starts at 6pm and dinner follows at 7pm, and reservations are required by calling (417) 882-0399 or reserving online. It takes place Thursday, November 19, 2026 at Vineyard Market, 1759 W State Hwy J in Ozark, MO.
